articles.title: ICE deports single dad of 6 American children after 34 years in the US
articles.summary: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has deported a single father who had resided in the United States for 34 years. This individual is the parent of six American-born children. The deportation highlights critical issues surrounding immigration enforcement, family separation, and the long-term implications for individuals who have established deep roots within the nation.

articles.title: Ancient African bedrock reveals the violent beginnings of life on our blue planet
articles.summary: Inspired by Mars rover images, scientists ponder a 'time machine' concept to explore Earth's deep geological past. This hypothetical tool would provide unprecedented insights into our planet's ancient history, from continental shifts to climatic changes, much like current space exploration. It aims to unlock mysteries of Earth's evolution, offering crucial data on its development over millions of years.

articles.title: Seven bodies recovered, 96 rescued after migrant boat capsizes, Gambia says
articles.summary: Gambia's defence ministry reported a tragic boat capsizing incident near Banjul, involving migrants. Seven bodies were recovered, and 96 individuals were successfully rescued overnight. This highlights the ongoing humanitarian crisis of illegal migration and the critical role of search and rescue operations in maritime security, often involving defence forces.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine trade allegations of civilian attacks on New Year's day
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine intensified accusations of targeting civilians over New Year. Moscow reported a deadly Ukrainian strike on a hotel in Russian-occupied southern Ukraine, killing at least five. Concurrently, Ukraine detailed extensive Russian missile and drone attacks nationwide, causing casualties and damage. Both nations condemned these actions, underscoring the severe civilian impact of the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Irvine Talks Scrapped “Green Lantern” Series
articles.summary: Before a leadership change at DC Studios with James Gunn and Peter Safran taking over, HBO Max was actively developing a TV series based on the iconic DC Comics property, Green Lantern. Arrow-verse creator Greg Berlanti was reportedly involved in this significant project, which commenced development in 2021/22, aiming to expand the DC universe on streaming platforms.

articles.title: In FY 2025-26, till Dec, Defence Ministry signed capital contracts amounting to Rs 1.82 lakh crore: Govt
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has committed Rs 1.82 lakh crore in capital contracts by December of financial year 2025-26 for the modernisation of India's armed forces. These substantial procurements signify a strong government focus on enhancing defence capabilities, ensuring advanced equipment for national security. This development highlights India's commitment to self-reliance and preparedness.
